subject: Request: VPC + On‑Prem Network & IAM Deep Dive — timing
messages:
From: Alice Moran <alice.moran@medcohealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medcohealth.com, infra@medcohealth.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC/on‑prem integration — request for architecture deep dive

Hi Sean / Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our infra and security leads would like a focused architecture deep dive on VPC connectivity, on‑prem VPN options, and how Redwood handles tenant IAM and KMS integrations before we move to procurement.

Key attendees: myself (AE sponsor), two devops engineers (infra@medcohealth.com), procurement (procurement@medcohealth.com), and our security PM (I'll loop them if available). We are in Pacific Time (PST).

Available windows next week: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT or Thu 13–16 PT. Can your team run a 60–75 minute session that covers: network topology, optional on‑prem VPN patterns, IAM/KMS mapping, and operational runbooks?

Would prefer a hands‑on discussion (not a slide‑only walkthrough).

Thanks —
Alice
Alice Moran
Program Manager, MedCo Health
alice.moran@medcohealth.com

Subject: Re: VPC/on‑prem integration — request for architecture deep dive

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear ask — we can do a hands‑on technical session. Camila (SE) and Karthik (runtime/infra lead) will cover the network and runtime bits; Laura from Security will cover IAM/KMS and audit controls.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 2026‑11‑03 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed 2026‑11‑04 11:30–12:45 PT
- Thu 2026‑11‑05 13:00–14:15 PT

If none of those work, tell us your single best slot and we will prioritize.

I attached a short proposed agenda and a current topology snapshot so you can share with your team (VPC‑deep‑dive‑agenda.pdf, current‑net‑topology.png).

Also: is there a preferred level of access for the session? (read‑only logging, demo tokens, or will this be purely architecture discussion?) That will determine whether we ask your devs to whitelist IPs or supply SSH keys for a short hands‑on walkthrough.

I will create a tentative calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC/on‑prem integration — request for architecture deep dive

Thanks — quick note on agenda/format from the SE side. Suggested 75‑minute breakdown:
- 0–10 min: Introductions + objectives (Alice)
- 10–35 min: VPC connectivity options + routing patterns (Camila)
- 35–55 min: On‑prem VPN/bastion patterns + demo of a sample tunnel (Karthik)
- 55–65 min: IAM/KMS mapping and audit trails (Laura)
- 65–75 min: Q&A + next steps / followups

For a hands‑on portion we typically ask devops to open a temporary access window and provide a small test VPC peering config or IP range we can target — nothing sensitive. If you prefer no live access, we will walk through a replay of a sanitized setup.

Also flagging two calendar constraints we saw on the attendees list: your procurement contact listed limits on vendor access (procurement@medcohealth.com). If procurement will be on the call we can keep the first 15 minutes high‑level so they get context and then move to the technical session for the rest.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Thanks for the options. Procurement can do Tue 11:00–12:15 PT (they had a conflict at 10). Devops prefers Thu 13:00–14:15 PT but two of our devs are only available Wed 11:30–12:45.

We want the full SE deep dive (devs need the demo), so Wed 11:30–12:45 PT is the preferred slot to maximize engineering attendance. If procurement wants to join for the first 15 minutes, that works — they said they can join the first half hour if needed.

Can Redwood confirm Wed 2026‑11‑04 11:30–12:45 PT and send an invite with dial‑in + link to the shared materials? Also please add any pre‑work or files we should review.

Cheers,
Alice
